keyEvents.text: First Half ends, Manchester City 0, Napoli 0.
Substitution, Manchester City. Jérémy Doku replaces Allan.
Goal! Manchester City 0, Napoli 1. Rasmus Højlund (Napoli) left footed shot from the centre of the box to the centre of the goal. Assisted by Billy Gilmour with a through ball.
Substitution, Manchester City. Iliman Ndiaye replaces Enzo Fernández.
Goal! Manchester City 1, Napoli 1. Ayyoub Bouaddi (Manchester City) left footed shot from the centre of the box to the high centre of the goal. Assisted by Jérémy Doku following a corner.
Substitution, Napoli. Giovane replaces Rasmus Højlund.
Substitution, Napoli. Frank Anguissa replaces Kevin De Bruyne.
Goal! Manchester City 1, Napoli 2. Noa Lang (Napoli) right footed shot from the centre of the box to the centre of the goal. Assisted by Leonardo Spinazzola with a cross.
Marc Guéhi (Manchester City) is shown the yellow card.
Goal! Manchester City 2, Napoli 2. Rayan Cherki (Manchester City) right footed shot from a difficult angle on the right to the bottom left corner. Assisted by Iliman Ndiaye.
Second Half ends, Manchester City 2, Napoli 2.
